inlines.v: INDULT'O, n. [L. indultus, indulged.] 1. In the church of Rome, the power of presenting to benefices, granted to certain persons, as to kings and cardinals.2. In Spain, a duty, tax or custom, paid to the king for all goods imported from the West Indies in the galleons.
